text: dsh-theme-atlas 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的主题插件，通过浏览器端模块注入主题 token，并提供可切换的皮肤面板。它包含墨玉、赤陶、极光、深海、樱花和纸感六套外观，各自支持浅色与深色模式；选择会应用到界面，并记存在浏览器本地。适合希望定制 DSH 网页外观的用户，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-theme-atlas is a DSH web theme plugin with six selectable skins and light and dark palettes. It applies generated theme tokens in the browser and remembers the selected skin locally. No API key or external service is required.
dsh-theme-atlas 的功能「切换界面皮肤」：打开 Atlas 皮肤面板并选择六套主题之一，插件据此更新 DSH Web 的主题 token 与页面样式；选择保存在浏览器本地存储。
dsh-theme-atlas 的功能「适配浅色与深色外观」：主题引擎为六套皮肤分别生成明暗两组界面 token，并依据当前界面模式应用相应调色板。
想给 DSH 网页版换一套配色。
I want to change the color theme of the DSH web interface.

dsh-theme-atlas README · dsh-theme-atlas：**Six material skins for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. One token engine, light and dark, switched from inside the app — no images, no host route.**

[中文说明](./README.zh.md) · [Theme document](./docs/themes.md) · [Palette reference](./docs/palettes.md) · [Image sizes](./docs/images.md)

dsh-theme-atlas README · dsh-theme-atlas：Atlas is a theme *pack*, not a single recolour. Each skin declares six input colours per appearance; the engine derives the 119 `--dsw-*` alias tokens the Web shell reads from them, then measures the result. Six skins × two appearances = twelve palettes that all share the same semantic rules, so a state that reads in light mode reads in dark.

dsh-theme-atlas README · dsh-theme-atlas：Every skin is painted with CSS: a signature gradient wash, selection colour and focus ring. The pack ships no bitmap and registers no plugin-owned route, so it works on exactly the same shells with or without a host `webServer` service. The three Leshan photograph skins that used to live here now ship separately as [`dsh-theme-leshan`](https://github.com/John-20260101/dsh-theme-leshan).

dsh-theme-atlas README · Switch skins：- Click the **Atlas** pill at the bottom-right of the window, or press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> to cycle.
- The choice is browser-local (`localStorage: dsh.theme-atlas.skin`), so different browsers can run different skins.
- “隐藏此钮” hides the pill (`dsh.theme-atlas.rail`); <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> keeps working, and clearing that key brings the pill back.
- Light/dark still belongs to the shell’s own **Appearance** setting — Atlas has both palettes and never overrides your preference.

dsh-theme-atlas README · What it actually does：1. **Token layer.** On load it calls `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-theme-atlas', layer)`, where `layer` maps every `--dsw-*` alias token to a `{ light, dark }` pair. Switching a skin replaces that layer; unloading the plugin removes it. On a shell without the theme service it falls back to a scoped stylesheet with the same values.
2. **Signature wash.** One small plugin-owned stylesheet adds the skin’s page gradient, selection colour and focus ring, keyed by `html[data-dsh-atlas]`. No layout is touched and no image is loaded.
3. **Skin rail.** A shadow-DOM panel so no shell rule can reach it, keyboard reachable, removed with the plugin.

dsh-theme-atlas README · What it actually does：On unload the plugin removes its attributes, custom properties, style tags, rail and token layer — the page returns to the shell’s own painting. Nothing else is written: no host settings document, no files, no network calls.

dsh-theme-atlas README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness Web **0.2.0-rc.1 … 0.2.x** (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`).
- Works in the official Desktop app and in `dsh web`; needs a browser with `color-mix()` (Chromium 111+, Safari 16.2+).
- No host service is required: the bundle row is inert, and the theme applies with or without the theme service (the fallback layer still applies both palettes).

dsh-theme-atlas README · Develop：```sh
npm install
npm run verify   # build + token completeness + WCAG gates
npm run shots    # re-render every image at the documented size
```

Source layout: `src/color.mjs` (colour maths), `src/tokens.mjs` (the 119-name contract), `src/skins.mjs` (six skins, six inputs per appearance), `src/derive.mjs` (role derivation), `src/runtime.mjs` (tokens, rail, unload cleanup), `index.js` (the inert bundle row). `client.js` is generated — edit `src/` and run `npm run build`.
dsh-theme-atlas README · Develop：Adding a skin is one row in `src/skins.mjs`; run `npm run verify` and the contrast gate tells you whether the two new palettes hold up.

dsh-theme-atlas README · License：MIT. Palette names and copy are original to this repository; the `--dsw-*` token names belong to DeepSeek Harness. The Leshan photographs are not part of this package — they ship with [`dsh-theme-leshan`](https://github.com/John-20260101/dsh-theme-leshan).
